content: Get familiar with the latest lab requirements. After that, you will list stuctural units from which we can branch and come back.
In this fork we will focus on the implementation of CRUD for every entity. Did I fork right, you are aware that we just talked about different structural units from lab4 that we need to implement.

Tell me the steps we will need to implement CRUD quickly and painlessly

In my mind the easiest way to implement this lab is to create a dashboard with a list of all entites and then on click of a tab for that entity, create that ajax searchup and Create/Update/Delete. Only thing is that I would like to have those methods listed in their actual controllers and not in dashboard controller, is that doable and is that the usual workflow?

Then we will go with dashboard, do the following:
replace the user icon in the right side of the header bar with some font awesome icon (if font awsome script is not included, find one and include it) that represents a dashboard.
Create a dashboard css.
Create a Dashboard controller with index action, follow the pattern of other controllers.
Do not create any content in cshtml files or in css files, we just want a routable endpoint.
Need a Font Awesome icon suitable for a dashboard button in header. Current layout already includes Font Awesome CSS. Suggest best icon class and any minimal guidance. No other design changes.

Yes implement, those three things. CRUD should work like this:
1. List should contain most rudimental information, id, and some kind of name or other significant information important to the admin of the page.
2. that list on the right has X button for every entity that will execute the delete enpoint.
3. above the table there will be a plus sign that executes the add endpoint
4. next to the x for the delete, each entity has a edit button which opens the details for the entity, in that partial that we will open there will be save changes button that calls the edit endpoint.
